story.text: 약속 시간이 코앞인데 버스는 감감무소식이었다. 선우가 도로 쪽으로 손을 번쩍 들며 택시를 잡았다.
story.reading: yak-sok si-gan-i ko-ap-in-de beo-seu-neun gam-gam-mu-so-sig-i-eot-da. seon-u-ga do-ro jjog-eu-ro son-eul beon-jjeok deul-myeo taek-si-reul jab-at-da.
story.en: Our appointment time was right around the corner, but there was no sign of the bus. Sunwoo shot his hand up toward the road and hailed a taxi.

story.text: "기사님, 광안리 쪽으로 가주세요." 그가 문을 열며 나부터 태우고는 재빨리 목적지를 말했다.
story.reading: "gi-sa-nim, gwang-an-ri jjog-eu-ro ga-ju-se-yo." geu-ga mun-eul yeol-myeo na-bu-teo tae-u-go-neun jae-ppal-li mok-jeok-ji-reul mal-haet-da.
story.en: "Sir, please head toward Gwangalli." He opened the door, got me in first, and quickly told the driver our destination.

story.text: "목적지까지 시간 얼마나 걸릴까요?" 내가 조심스레 묻자 기사님이 웃으며 대답했다. "금방입니다, 지름길로 가면 되니까요."
story.reading: "mok-jeok-ji-kka-ji si-gan eol-ma-na geol-lil-kka-yo?" nae-ga jo-sim-seu-re mut-ja gi-sa-nim-i us-eu-myeo dae-dap-haet-da. "geum-bang-im-ni-da, ji-reum-gil-lo ga-myeon doe-ni-kka-yo."
story.en: "How long will it take to get to our destination?" I asked carefully, and the driver answered with a laugh. "It'll be quick, we'll take a shortcut."

story.text: 내비게이션 화면 속 파란 선이 낯선 골목으로 안내하자 선우가 고개를 갸웃했다. "어? 이 길 맞나?"
story.reading: nae-bi-ge-i-syeon hwa-myeon sok pa-ran seon-i nat-seon gol-mog-eu-ro an-nae-ha-ja seon-u-ga go-gae-reul gya-ut-haet-da. "eo? i gil mat-na?"
story.en: As the blue line on the navigation screen guided us into an unfamiliar alley, Sunwoo tilted his head. "Huh? Is this the right way?"

story.text: "기사님이 아시는 지름길이 더 빠릅니다." 기사님의 자신만만한 말에 선우도 순순히 고개를 끄덕였다.
story.reading: "gi-sa-nim-i a-si-neun ji-reum-gil-i deo ppa-reum-ni-da." gi-sa-nim-ui ja-sin-man-man-han mal-e seon-u-do sun-sun-hi go-gae-reul kkeu-deok-yeot-da.
story.en: "The shortcut I know is faster." At the driver's confident words, Sunwoo obediently nodded along.

story.text: 택시가 목적지 앞에 멈춰 서자, 선우는 재빨리 지갑을 꺼내 요금을 계산했다. "내가 낼게, 오늘은."
story.reading: taek-si-ga mok-jeok-ji ap-e meom-chwo seo-ja, seon-u-neun jae-ppal-li ji-gab-eul kkeo-nae yo-geum-eul gye-san-haet-da. "nae-ga nael-ge, o-neul-eun."
story.en: As the taxi pulled up in front of our destination, Sunwoo quickly pulled out his wallet and paid the fare. "I'll pay, today."
"Go through the words and conversation as if you're finding a shortcut — have fun with it."

words.example_en: I entered the destination into the navigation app.
This alley is a shortcut, so it's faster.
It's hard to find your way without navigation.
The taxi fare came out higher than expected.

sentences.en: I told the taxi driver our destination.
This road is a shortcut, so it's faster.
The navigation suddenly gave the wrong directions.
The fare came out to more than expected.
We've almost arrived at our destination.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.en: Sir, please head toward Minrak Waterside Park in Gwangalli.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 이 시간에 그쪽 길 안 막힐까?
turns.reading: i si-gan-e geu-jjok gil an mak-hil-kka?
turns.en: Won't that road be jammed at this hour?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 기사님이 지름길 아신다니까 금방 갈 끼다.
turns.reading: gi-sa-nim-i ji-reum-gil a-sin-da-ni-kka geum-bang gal kki-da.
turns.en: The driver knows a shortcut, so we'll get there quickly.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: That's a relief then. It'd be a big problem if we're late.

dialogues.question: 선우와 승객이 향하고 있는 목적지는 어디인가요?
dialogues.question_en: Where are Sunwoo and the passenger headed?
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 기사님께 광안리 민락수변공원 쪽으로 가 달라고 목적지를 말했습니다.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 어? 내비가 자꾸 이상한 골목으로 가라는데?
turns.reading: eo? nae-bi-ga ja-kku i-sang-han gol-mog-eu-ro ga-ra-neun-de?
turns.en: Huh? The navigation keeps telling us to go down some weird alley?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 가끔 저래 오류난다. 기사님, 그냥 아시는 길로 가도 될까요?
turns.reading: ga-kkeum jeo-rae o-ryu-nan-da. gi-sa-nim, geu-nyang a-si-neun gil-lo ga-do doel-kka-yo?
turns.en: It glitches like that sometimes. Sir, could you just take the way you know?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 그럽시다, 내가 이 동네 삼십 년 살았어요.
turns.reading: geu-reop-si-da, nae-ga i dong-ne sam-sip nyeon sal-at-eo-yo.
turns.en: Sure thing, I've lived in this neighborhood for thirty years.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.en: See, a person really is better than a machine.

dialogues.question: 내비게이션에 문제가 생겼을 때 세 사람은 어떻게 했나요?
dialogues.question_en: What did the three of them do when the navigation had a problem?
dialogues.explanation: 내비게이션이 이상한 길을 안내하자 세 사람은 삼십 년간 동네에 산 기사님이 아는 길로 가기로 했습니다.
